title: Antevo Research
description: Ask an Antevo research desk a question and get its written answer, every fact dated.

tools.name: ask_desk
tools.description: Ask one Antevo research desk a question and get its written answer, with its facts dated, how much recent research it read and the newest item's date. Desks: `economy` (economies, growth, inflation, central banks and interest rates, labour markets, public finances, currencies); `geopolitics` (conflicts, sanctions, elections and policy shifts, trade and supply chains, and what they mean for economies and markets); `shipping` (seaborne trade, freight and charter markets, ports and chokepoints, fleets, air cargo); `real_estate` (residential and commercial property markets, house prices and rents, mortgage and lending conditions); `strategy` (the big picture across economies, markets, geopolitics and commodities: how the pieces connect, the main scenarios and what would change them); `commodities` (oil, gas and power, metals, farm goods: supply, demand, stocks, positioning); `markets` (how markets are behaving: volatility, risk appetite, how assets move together, rates and currencies; describes conditions, never advises); `technology` (artificial intelligence, semiconductors, cloud and software, tech policy and supply chains); `digital_assets` (crypto assets, stablecoins, on-chain finance and their rules); `health` (medicines and the approval calendar, clinical trials, health systems and policy); `rates` (government bond yields and curves, central-bank policy paths, inflation expectations, credit and funding conditions); `mortgages` (mortgage rates and how they are set, fixed against variable and SARON-linked loans, lending and affordability rules, housing credit and its policy); `equities` (listed companies: results, margins and cash flow, debt, valuation against their own history and their peers, dividends and results dates; one company or several side by side, Swiss companies included); `technical` (how a share, index, currency, commodity or coin has been trading: its trend against its moving averages, momentum, how stretched it is, its range and volatility, with a saved picture of the last year; describes, never signals); `etfs` (exchange-traded funds: what a fund holds, where its money sits by country, sector and currency, what it pays out, how its price has moved, and how two or three funds compare and overlap; describes, never picks); `results` (company results: who reports when, how results came out against expectations, what management said on the call, and how the season is going by market; describes, never advises); `swiss` (companies listed in Switzerland and the Swiss market: results, valuation and dividends of Swiss companies, the SMI's trend, the Swiss results season and dividend dates; describes, never advises); `private_markets` (venture capital, private equity and credit, start-ups, IPOs and fundraising). Pass the user's question in full as `question` (up to 2,000 characters) and the desk that fits it as `desk`; for a question that spans two desks, ask each, or ask `strategy` for the joined-up view. Leave `level` as `standard`. An answer takes up to a minute or two; when the same question was answered in the last day that answer comes back at once, marked `reused` with `written_at`. Pass `fresh` as true only when the user wants a newly written answer.
